description: The version of all installed E8 databases
body:
USE master;
EXEC dbo.sp_ineachdb
    @command = N'
		DECLARE @DbName NVARCHAR(255) = DB_NAME();
		DECLARE @UsesNewVersion BIT = 0;
		IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES AS T WHERE T.TABLE_SCHEMA = ''dbo'' AND T.TABLE_NAME = ''VersionHistory'')
			SET @UsesNewVersion = 1;
		
		DECLARE	@SQL NVARCHAR(MAX) =
			N''USE ['' + @DbName + ''];
			SELECT DB_NAME(), * 
			FROM
				(
					SELECT E.OwnerName, E.ERONationID
					FROM ['' + @DbName + ''].dbo.ERO AS E
				) AS ero
				CROSS JOIN ('' 
				+ CASE WHEN @UsesNewVersion = 1 
					THEN 
						''SELECT TOP (1) CONCAT(VH.Major, ''''.'''', VH.Minor, ''''.'''', VH.Build, ''''.'''', VH.Revision) AS VERSION, NULL AS Branch, VH.UpdateDate
						FROM ['' + @DbName + ''].dbo.VersionHistory AS VH
						ORDER BY VH.VersionHistoryID DESC'' 
					ELSE 
						''SELECT TOP(1) 
							SL.Version,
							CASE 
								WHEN CHARINDEX(''''Script run on'''', SL.Description) > 2 THEN SUBSTRING(SL.Description, 1, CHARINDEX(''''Script run on'''', SL.Description) - 2) 
								ELSE '''''''' 
							END AS Branch, 
							SL.DateApplied AS [Last Updated]
						FROM ['' + @DbName + ''].dbo.ScriptLog AS SL
						WHERE SL.Version <> ''''0.0.0''''
						ORDER BY
							CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING(SL.Version, 0, CHARINDEX(''''.'''', SL.Version))) DESC,
							CONVERT(INT, SUBSTRING(SL.Version, CHARINDEX(''''.'''', SL.Version) + 1, CHARINDEX(''''.'''', SL.Version, CHARINDEX(''''.'''', SL.Version) + 1) - CHARINDEX(''''.'''', SL.Version) - 1)) DESC,
							CONVERT(DECIMAL(6,3), SUBSTRING(SL.Version, CHARINDEX(''''.'''', SL.Version, CHARINDEX(''''.'''', SL.Version) + 1) + 1, 1000)) DESC,
							SL.DateApplied DESC''
				END
				+ '') AS ver
				CROSS JOIN (
					SELECT SUM(F.size) * 8 / 1024.0 / 1024.0 AS [Total Size (GB)]
					FROM
						(
							SELECT DF.size
							FROM ['' + @DbName + ''].sys.database_files AS DF
							UNION ALL
							SELECT DF.size
							FROM ['' + @DbName + ''PrivateInfo].sys.database_files AS DF
						) AS F
				) AS size'';
		EXEC sp_executesql @stmt = @SQL',
    @user_only = 1,
    @name_pattern = N'Elector8%',
    @exclude_pattern = N'%PrivateInfo',
    @exclude_list = N'Elector8Portal,Elector8Portal.Old';
